builds.summary: Heartbreaker combines 1.2 AD with explicit .7 crit-stat factor and (20+.05 AD[statFormula=2])% missing-HP physical damage. Crit/IE interaction is conditional on raw Stat(8)/(9) mapping.
builds.goal: Heartbreaker combines 1.2 AD with explicit .7 crit-stat factor and (20+.05 AD[statFormula=2])% missing-HP physical damage. Crit/IE interaction is conditional on raw Stat(8)/(9) mapping.
builds.hypothesis:
Viego discards any souls he is currently Possessing and teleports. On arrival he Attacks the champion with the lowest percent Health, briefly Slowing them by [99]% and dealing [((1.2) × AD) × ((1 + ((0.7) × Stat(8)) × (((1) × Stat(9) + -1))))] + [12 / 16 / 20 + (0.05) × AD[statFormula=2]]% missing Health physical damage. Other nearby enemies are Knocked Back and take [((1.2) × AD) × ((1 + ((0.7) × Stat(8)) × (((1) × Stat(9) + -1))))] physical damage.
Bloodthirster supplies 80 AD; Infinity Edge/Collector/Essence Reaver/LDR provide crit/AD for the explicitly stated crit interaction; LDR penetrates armor, Profane supplies AD/lethality. Spellblade/on-hits are separate. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers.

testPlan: Finite benchmark: Level 18, selected ability max rank; minute 30, no external ally buffs or dragons, 3000 max-HP target with 1500 bonus HP, 100 armor/50 MR and 29% starting HP unless objective overrides. Heartsteel exactly 500 earned HP if present; self 10% HP for Bloodmail. Seraph earned from fully stacked Tear. Rune gathering time fixed at 30min; item combat ramps ready.

Native unpossessed form, fixed 29% target HP; R one target, no possession resets; measure crit-factor swap. Log raw kit packet(s), post-mitigation damage and separate item/rune packets; repeat at 100% target HP and swap one item at a time. First Strike must be ready and champion initiates; compare eligible bonus separately.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The form loads the recorded target slot and any explicit benchmark overrides; other fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR). Adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.
failureConditions: The candidate loses the intended packet gain after real mitigation, charge restrictions, proc behavior or buff eligibility is measured.

Unlimited game time changes Gathering Storm; no finite global maximum over unrestricted time. Damage cannot exceed remaining HP as an observed health loss; record theoretical packet separately. Crit does not automatically multiply spells/pets/procs.
tradeoffs: Six completed items assume late boots sell/swap; movement and practical survival/access are sacrificed for the number. Bloodthirster, Infinity Edge, Lord Dominik's Regards, Essence Reaver, The Collector, Profane Hydra. Required setup damage is excluded from scored ability. Defensive or attack-speed replacements may win real fights despite a lower isolated packet.
Confidence: speculative. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.
